name: Aadhaar Authentication API Specification
description: World's largest biometric digital-identity authentication API. Technical specification for biometric and demographic authentication against Aadhaar, used by all AUAs (Authentication User Agencies) and KUAs (KYC User Agencies). Aadhaar has 1.3B+ enrolled identities.
